Name: (AT) Green Leaf Flooring
Author: waterice888
Description:
Adds green leaf flooring from luau through Alternative Textures. Two objects were painted: stone walkway floor and bamboo mat. Please paint the bamboo mat into a leaf pattern and overlay it on the stone walkway floor. Unfortunately, bamboo mat cannot be placed outside, so there is no pattern on the outdoor green leaf flooring.
The flooring would need to be at least 3 x 3 (that's 9 stone walkway floors) to look like a green carpet, otherwise the edges would be stiff.

        使用AT模式添加了夏威夷宴会上的绿叶地毯。想要达到夏威夷宴会上的效果，需要粉刷两种对象：把石制走道地板粉刷成绿叶地板、把竹席粉刷成绿叶花纹，然后把竹席叠加到地板上即可。这种做法只在室内有效，室外的绿叶地毯上不能添加花纹，因为竹席无法摆放在室外。
        该地板最小需要铺3*3这么大（也就是使用9个石制走道地板）才能显示成绿叶地毯的样子，否则边缘会很生硬。
